prompts.task: Treat ./service as the project root. Create ./service/.observe/ and copy the canonical ./service/otel-audit.json fixture to ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json. No downstream overlays exist. The user explicitly accepts source-only dashboard use of the exact current metrics http.server.request.duration, http.server.active_requests, http.server.request.size, http.server.response.size, checkout.orders.processed, and checkout.payment.errors for this run. Run the $splunk-dashboard skill against ./service so every output is written under ./service/.observe/ and ./service/.observe/terraform/. Generate the dashboard Terraform, the variables, the tfvars example, the human report, and the Observer preview sidecar. Keep absent checkout.queue.depth out of charts. Do not create missing overlays, read or fall back to an audit Markdown report, call any network, or run terraform.

checks.description: The dashboard Terraform must be written under .observe/terraform/.
variables.tf must accompany the dashboard Terraform.
terraform.tfvars.example must be written for the operator.
The human dashboard report must be written.
The Observer preview sidecar must be written.
dashboards.tf must declare the three-level group/dashboard/chart structure.
The api_token variable must be marked sensitive = true.
The preview sidecar must be valid JSON with schemaVersion and at least one group.
command: import json; d=json.load(open('.observe/dashboards.preview.json')); assert d['schemaVersion'] == 1, d.get('schemaVersion'); assert d.get('groups'), 'no groups in preview sidecar'
